# fpcloud_secret (Data Source)

Read an organization secret bundle and its decrypted values. Reading requires org write permission — revealing a bundle is a privileged, audited operation. The values land in Terraform state in plaintext, so the state backend must be treated as a secret store (see the remote-state guide).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read an org secret bundle and wire it into an app, without ever putting the
# values in the configuration.
data "fpcloud_secret" "backend" {
  org_id = var.org_id
  name   = "argus-backend"
}

resource "fpcloud_app" "api" {
  project = fpcloud_project.demo.name
  name    = "api"
  image   = "registry.cloud.fogpipe.com/acme/demo/api:v1"

  # Multi-line values (a PEM, an APNs .p8 key) survive intact here; the old
  # `fpcloud secrets get | jq > TF_VAR_*` workaround could not carry them.
  secret = data.fpcloud_secret.backend.data
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Bundle name, e.g. "argus-backend".
- `org_id` (String) Organization that owns the bundle.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Map of String, Sensitive) The bundle's decrypted key/value pairs.
- `id` (String) The bundle's ID.
- `keys` (List of String) The bundle's key names, without values.
- `targets` (List of String) Project IDs the bundle is mirrored into.
